units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 4:3">Keth. IV, 3</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 22:21">Deut. XXII, 21</cite>) <he>אין לה לא פ׳ בית האב וכ׳</he> if she (the faithless betrothed) has no paternal house door.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:6">Y. Sabb. VII, 9ᶜ</cite> top <he>ניכר הוא … על פִּיתְחָהּ של תירה</he> it can be seen that this man has never passed the gate of the Law (never studied).

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:11:1">Koh. R. to III, 11</cite> <he>זה הפ׳ פתוח עד התהום</he> this gate (verse used as introductory text, v. <cite ref="Q02143"><he>פָּתַח</he></cite>) opens to the deep, i.e. leads to deep reflection.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 85:7">Gen. R. s. 85</cite> (ref. to <he>פתח עינים</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 38:14">Gen. XXXVIII, 14</cite>) <he>תלה עיניה בפ׳ שכל העינים וכ׳</he> she lifted up her eyes to the gate to which all eyes are directed (she prayed to the Lord).
Gen. R. s. 38 פתח … פ׳ של תשובה the Lord opened to them the gate of repentance; a. fr.—Euphem. פ׳ פָּתוּחַ absence of virginity Keth. 9ᵇ טענת פ׳ פ׳, contrad. to טענת דמים, v. דָּם.

<cite ref="Ketubot 9a:1">Ib. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>ופ׳ פ׳ כשני עדים דמי</he> and the husband’s statement that lie found ‘the gate open’ is like a statement of two witnesses (to make her forbidden to him as a faithless betrothed); a. fr.—Trnsf.

senses.gloss: an opening for retracting a vow, a suggestion, v. פָּתַח.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91:3">Gen. R. s. 91</cite> <he>למאה … מצא להם פ׳</he> for one hundred and fifty Nazarites he found causes for absolution; a. fr.—
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 2:1">Arakh. II, 1</cite> <he>אין פ׳ בטועה וכ׳</he> for a woman that has lost the account of a prolonged flux, there is no new starting point within either less than seven or more than seventeen days.
<cite ref="Arakhin 8a:14">Ib. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>פִּתְחָהּ שבעה עשר</he> her sure starting point is after seventeen days; a. fr.—Pl. <he>פְּתָחִים</he>, <he>פְּתָחִין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 9:1">B. Bath. IX, 1</cite> <he>ישאלו על הפ׳</he> let them go begging at the doors; <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 13:3">Keth. XIII, 3</cite> <he>יחזרו על הפ׳</he>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:2:2">Cant. R. to V, 2</cite> <he>פתחו לי פתח … ואני פותח לכם פ׳ וכ׳</he> make for me one opening for return as wide as the point of a needle, and I shall open for you gates through which wagons and coaches can pass; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:18">Ab. III, 18</cite> <he>פִּתְחֵי נדה</he> the calculations concerning starting points of menstruants (v. supra).
senses.label: b
